title: Corn, twenty-eight
logline: September 12. The corn, and this year the tray is on the motel desk at 7 AM — the morning shift now — with the bell beside it. The hum line not drawn; the shift is day.

panels.composition: A paper tray of corn on the motel's front desk in morning light beside the brass bell, the register closed, the glass door bright with day, no clerk in frame. No line beneath the page.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a paper tray of buttered corn on a motel front desk in morning light beside a brass bell with a closed register and a bright glass door, no people, no line beneath the page, no words
image.notes: Morning shifts by 2025 (the brief: 2026). No hum line: day.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Twenty-eight. Corn at the desk, by day.
